text:
maria-cs: Hey team — Thunderbird Health onboarding demo tomorrow. They hit a token spike during the dry-run and reported latency in APAC. Can we provision a temporary regional allowlist + a short rate-lift for ap-southeast-1 and eu-central-1? Renewal is at risk if the pilot doesn't look stable.
ben-ops: Copy. Can you paste the customer CIDRs and expected QPS? Also what’s the renewal timeline?
maria-cs: TB sent: `203.0.113.45/32` and `198.51.100.0/24`. Expect short bursts up to ~800 qps, maybe a 30m sustained spike. Renewal decision in ~30 days, execs flagged two latency hiccups in the last demo.
liam-net: We can add those CIDRs to an allowlist and create a TEMP rate window. Recommend 24h TTL with auto-revoke, pin routing to ap-southeast-1 + eu-central-1 to reduce cross-region hops. Need sec approval for CIDRs.
harper-sec: Quick question — will TB send any sensitive PII raw to our hosted models? They said pseudonymized logs but we need a recorded AUP/handshake. For the temp allowlist we require TTL + auto-revoke and audit logging. 24h sounds fine if ticket notes are present.
olivia-ae: I'll flag renewal risk with the account team and prep a short executive note. Also suggest we schedule a 20min runbook call with their infra lead before demo.
maria-cs: TB infra lead is alex@thunderbird (I pinged him). He confirmed those IPs and said they can push up to ~1k qps for a 30min window if needed.
ben-ops: Plan: create allowlist rule `AL-1724-thunderbird`, rate policy `TEMP_BURST_24H` with peak up to 1200 qps, permissive bursts, and pinned routing. I'll apply at 10:00 UTC unless any objections. Command I'm going to run:
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{
  "name": "AL-1724-thunderbird",
  "cidrs": ["203.0.113.45/32","198.51.100.0/24"],
  "ttl": "24h",
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```
liam-net: LGTM. After apply I'll warm KV cache for their common prefixes to shave cold-starts.
harper-sec: Add a note to CS ticket #CS-8892 referencing the AUP placeholder. If traffic looks anomalous we'll pause the rule.
deploy-bot: allowlist AL-1724-thunderbird scheduled at 2026-03-24T10:00:00Z by ben-ops
maria-cs: thanks :pray: I'll loop in their infra lead and follow up with a post-demo feedback survey to capture latency numbers and satisfaction. Will also mark renewal watch.
olivia-ae: Noted — I'll add a renewal playbook item and set a reminder for 7 days post-demo.
ben-ops: Applied. Confirmed AL created and routing pinned. Monitoring shows successful connection and no error spikes so far. Keep updates in this thread.
maria-cs: Demo complete — latency stable, sustained peak ~700 qps for ~10 mins. TB requested we add partner CIDR `203.0.114.0/24` for partner traffic for 4h ephemeral access. Can we do a 4h add?
harper-sec: We can allow an ephemeral 4h addition with manual approval and audit log. Send the partner CIDR in the ticket and I'll sign off.
ben-ops: Adding `203.0.114.0/24` now with TTL 4h. Auto-revoke scheduled +4h. AL-1724 updated to include partner CIDR.
maria-cs: Great — demo success, renewal risk downgraded from at-risk -> warm. I'll update CRM and send a short NPS/latency pulse to TB.
olivia-ae: I'll update CRM and schedule a 2-week check-in call. Nice work everyone!
